# PostPlan

> Authenticated artifact publishing for agents. From documents, reports, and specifications to interactive bundled applications.

PostPlan accepts self-contained HTML, one page or a folder of linked pages, up to 4 MiB per upload. Inline scripts run in a sandbox.

## Quick Start

- Install the CLI: `npm install -g postplan@latest`
- Download the skill file. `<agents-global-config-dir>` is your agent's user-level config directory: `~/.claude` for Claude Code, `~/.codex` for Codex, and `~/.agents` for many other agents.
   ```sh
   cd <agents-global-config-dir>
   mkdir -p skills/postplan
   curl -fsSL -o skills/postplan/SKILL.md https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/SKILL.md
   ```
- Open https://postplan.mcking.in/cli/auth in the user's browser. Ask them to generate an API key and paste it back. If the browser does not open, share the link and ask them to open it manually.
- Run: `postplan auth set <pasted-key> --api-url https://postplan.mcking.in`
- Run: `postplan check --api-url https://postplan.mcking.in`. It prints the account and limits, then `Ready.`

To update the CLI and the skill, re-run steps 1 and 2. If the skill file already exists, diff before overwriting to preserve any local changes.

## Documentation

- [PostPlan Skill](https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/SKILL.md): Reading and uploading drafts, document rules, writing rules, anti-patterns, the direct API, and error handling.

## API

`<id>` is the draft ID or the custom URL.

- POST /api/uploads: upload or update a draft (bearer auth)
- POST /api/check: validate an upload and check a custom URL without publishing (bearer auth)
- GET /api/drafts: list drafts (bearer auth)
- GET /api/me: account info (bearer auth)
- GET /d/<id>: serve current version (public)
- GET /d/<id>/version/<n>: serve specific version (public)
- GET /d/<id>/<page>: serve a page of a folder draft (public)
- GET /d/<id>/version/<n>/<page>: serve a page of a specific version (public)
